title: Software Engineer – Python & Infrastructure Automation (Contract)
description:
Software Engineer – Python & Infrastructure Automation (Contract)

Location: Vilnius, Lithuania

Contract: 6 months rolling

Hourly rate: Up to €45 per hour

I'm currently partnering with a leading international financial services organisation looking for an experienced Software Engineer to join its infrastructure and automation engineering team.

You will be responsible for developing scalable backend services, modernising workflow orchestration platforms and building secure automation solutions across enterprise networking and hybrid cloud environments.

Responsibilities:
Design, develop and maintain Python-based backend applications and REST APIs.
Build scalable workflow orchestration and infrastructure automation solutions.
Develop self-service tooling for enterprise infrastructure and network operations.
Build security-critical automation services covering certificate management, firewalls and threat mitigation.
Own software delivery from API design and testing through to CI/CD and production monitoring.
Support the expansion of hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure.
Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability, scalability and performance.
Requirements:
Strong commercial experience with Python backend development.
Experience with Django REST Framework, FastAPI or similar frameworks.
Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Temporal.io, or a willingness to learn.
Strong experience with enterprise infrastructure automation.
Experience with AWS, Terraform and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift or EKS.
Understanding of REST APIs and modern software architecture.
Familiarity with networking technologies, including firewalls, load balancers and DNS.
Strong understanding of secure software development practices.
This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a large-scale infrastructure modernisation programme, working with modern technologies in a complex enterprise environment.

If you're interested in discussing the opportunity, please apply or contact me directly.
